# t3.1a — Domain Modules Relocated

## Summary

Moved the shared settings contract, default channel records, and video-format rules into `src/domain`. Converted the channel and video-format modules to TypeScript, updated application/service imports, and kept the Node test suite loading the TypeScript domain rules directly. Domain rules remain pure and independent of React Native, Expo, network, and storage.

Changed paths:
- `domain/settings.ts` → `src/domain/settings.ts`
- `constants/channels.js` → `src/domain/defaultChannels.ts`
- `services/filters.js` → `src/domain/videoFormat.ts`
- Updated importers in `App.js`, `components/ShortsShelf.js`, `screens/{FeedScreen,OfflineScreen,PlayerScreen}.js`, `services/{feed,formats,settings,storage}.js/ts`, and the video-format tests.

## Upstream Artifacts Consumed

- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t2-architect.md` — followed its domain ownership map, TypeScript extensions, and Node-test compatibility guidance.

## Evidence Mapping

- `t2-architect.md#Shared UI, domain rules, and utilities` → the three mapped domain modules now live under `src/domain`.
- `t2-architect.md#Architecture Decision` → `videoFormat.ts` contains pure classification rules; all listed consumers use the new module paths.
